lastCompletedStory.title: Accept any conventional-commit type prefix in the commit-existence gate

nextStoryContext: commitSubjectMatchesStory (src/supervisor/result.ts) now accepts any lowercase conventional-commit type prefix (^[a-z]+(?:\([^)]*\))?!?:), not just feat:, mirroring the release-side idiom already used in src/release/bump.ts (BREAKING_BANG_RE) and src/release/changelog.ts (STRIP_PREFIX_RE). Those release-side matchers were intentionally left untouched (separate concern, per this story's notes) -- if a future story wants to share the regex fragment across the supervisor/release boundary, that is a new decision, not implied by this change. The bracketed-or-bare id alternation and the immediately-following-separator prefix-collision guard are unchanged.
